card.name: Single digits before a decimal point
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 4, 5 or 9 that is followed by a decimal point or a closing bracket. Most often it is the first digit of a number like 4.5% in a trial results sentence.

modes.label: Digit before decimal
modes.description: A digit that begins a decimal percentage in a trial death-rate sentence.

modes.label: Digit in a table value
modes.description: A digit within a number in a table of measurements.

card.plain: It fires on a lone digit that is about to be followed by a decimal point, as in 4.5%.
